title: Maybe You Should Talk to Someone
author: Lori Gottlieb
summary: Therapist Lori Gottlieb describes her own work with several patients while she herself seeks therapy after a breakup. The book shows how people change and what happens in the therapy room.
readIf: you are curious about therapy and like warm, humane stories about ordinary struggles.
skipIf: you want a self-help manual with exercises and clear steps.
